text:
Aisha (CSM): Heads up — Acme QBR on Thurs. Need a final slide pack + 2x exec talking points. Can owners confirm what they’ll take and ETA? Draft here: https://docs.redwood/invite/qbr-acme (please comment on the doc).

Liam - Solutions: I can take the adoption & usage metrics slide. Will add cohort numbers and activation funnel by EOD. @Aisha (CSM)

Beth - CS Ops: I’ll own renewal & risk slide. Quick Q: do we have the updated MRR churn forecast from finance?

Suresh (Eng): For the tech slide — can someone confirm if we want a short note on Dedicated perf improvements? I can craft a 1-liner.

Maya (Design): I’ll polish visuals tonight. Prefer 16:9 and fewer bullet-heavy slides, will post a v2.

Tom (CS Manager): Also we should add a short “SLOs & fallback” bullet for execs — who can summarize the canary/fallback policy? @Suresh (Eng)

Liam - Solutions: putting the numbers now. FYI — embedding latency improved ~12% after batching tweak; should we call that out?

Aisha (CSM): Yes call out the latency win as a quick customer-impact bullet. Summary of owners: Adoption -> Liam; Renewal/risk -> Beth; Perf/tech -> Suresh; Visuals -> Maya; Exec bullets/ops -> Tom. Please update the doc with owner name + ETA.

RunbookBot: Reminder — QBR slide deadline in 48h. Please push changes to the 'final' folder by 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC. :robot_face:

Beth - CS Ops: Draft for risk slide by EOD today, will need a quick review after I add forecasts.

Suresh (Eng): Suggested 1-liner: 'Dedicated capacity tuning reduced p50 latency by 24% for 16k-seq workloads.' I’ll drop that into the tech slide and can shorten for exec speak.

Maya (Design): Uploaded v2 assets + a condensed layout suggestion. Link: https://design.redwood/assets/acme-qbr-v2 (please review)

Tom (CS Manager): Dry run Wed 09:30 PT — 30 min. Can folks join? Need to lock order and handoff cues.

Aisha (CSM): I’ll schedule and add slide order. Ping me any blockers or if you need more than 5 mins for your section.

Liam - Solutions: In for the dry run.

Beth - CS Ops: In.

Suresh (Eng): I can do if we keep the tech bit to a 3-min top-line.

Maya (Design): I’ll join first 10 to hand off visuals.

Aisha (CSM): One last ask — capture the top 3 renewal risks under the 'Risks' section and tag owners. Example bullet format to copy:

- Feature gap: Onboarding flows not fully instrumented — Owner: Liam
- Cost concerns: unexpected token usage spike — Owner: Beth
- Security review delay: SOC2 evidence pending — Owner: Tom

Beth - CS Ops: Adding the bullets now and will annotate mitigation steps.

RunbookBot: Deploy notice — slides/final/v2 pushed by Maya at 1768529755.

Aisha (CSM): Nice work everyone — I’ll do a quick pass after Beth and Liam update. Thanks!
